in_sanskrit.name: Sadhil
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Learned, Wise, Scholar
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sadhil एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sadhil', meaning 'Learned, Wise, Scholar'. A name for a boy who is expected to grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable individual.

in_hindi.name: Sadhil
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Learned, Wise, Scholar
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sadhil एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sadhil', meaning 'Learned, Wise, Scholar'. A name for a boy who is expected to grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable individual.

in_tamil.name: Sadhil

in_telugu.name: Sadhil

in_marathi.name: Sadhil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Learned, Wise, Scholar
